in_marathi.name: Anasuya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anasuya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anasuya is a Sanskrit name, derived from the term anasuya, which means faultless, impeccable, or sinless. In Hindu mythology, Anasuya was a virtuous wife of the sage Atri and the mother of the divine sage Dattatreya. She is known for her immense devotion, purity, and wisdom.
